acceptance_gates: No multiprocessing import remains in new scientific modules outside infinity_grid.execution and frozen historical replay assets.
All migrated lanes pass 1-worker vs N-worker normalized science-hash equality.
Checkpointed parallel chunk execution resumes only missing work.
Two concurrent Decoder runs obey one host CPU budget.
Worker crash and duplicate/missing task tests fail closed.
macOS-safe serial/spawn-compatible behavior is documented and tested where feasible.

future_optional_backends: REMOTE_PROCESS_WORKER on Hetzner without changing TaskSpec semantics
architecture.rule: scientific modules declare deterministic tasks and canonical merge; only Decoder execution core owns multiprocessing/process pools

checkpointing.concurrent_claims: must be atomic and process-safe before enabling multiple workers on the same checkpoint directory
checkpointing.corruption: fail closed, never silently recompute a mismatching checkpoint in an official run
checkpointing.resume: verified completed tasks/chunks are reused; only missing work runs

migration.phase_1: implement infinity_grid.execution + unit tests; no scientific adapter changes
migration.phase_2: parallelize existing conveyor wide_chunked via unified backend and prove serial equality
migration.phase_3: replace exact_carrier_parallel direct Pool calls with backend calls; keep API compatibility shim
migration.phase_4: expose O7 historical weighted-sharding strategy through an adapter; do not rewrite historical replay source
migration.phase_5: add global CPU leases/status and integrate with detached controller

nonclaims: This is execution architecture only. It earns no algebra/O-level theorem and changes no observer, action law, panel, stopping rule or scientific claim.
const.purpose: Provide one Decoder-owned multicore execution service for every deterministic parallel-safe scientific workload without changing scientific semantics.

resource_contract.host_budget: one runtime-wide CPU lease pool; concurrent runs share the same budget
resource_contract.nested_worker_depth: workers may not create child process pools
resource_contract.oversubscription: forbidden unless explicitly execution-only override is recorded
resource_contract.reserve_cores: policy, not scientific code; may be zero on dedicated host or nonzero on interactive host

scheduler_strategies.CHECKPOINTED_CHUNKS: use existing ChunkCheckpointStore; compute only missing verified chunks; canonical merge afterward
scheduler_strategies.COST_WEIGHTED_SHARDS: port the O7 v0.2.3 deterministic weight/shard idea; target more shards than workers to reduce long-tail imbalance

required_equivalence_tests: workers=1 vs workers=2 normalized science hash
workers=1 vs workers=AUTO normalized science hash
different deterministic chunk/shard granularities give identical normalized science output
science_firewall.selection_after_merge: all scientific capping, farthest selection, witness choice and final hashing occur only after canonical collection unless formally proved distributive

start_method_contract.large_readonly_data: use worker initializer/shared read-only state/materialized file references rather than scientific globals where portability requires it
start_method_contract.linux_default: forkserver or safe fresh-process fork after validation; exact policy chosen once in implementation
start_method_contract.macos_default: spawn/forkserver compatible path required for portability; fork-only scientific APIs are deprecated

task_contract.failure: missing/duplicate task, worker exception, stale binding or corrupt checkpoint fails closed
task_contract.merge: caller-supplied canonical deterministic merge or ordered task-id collection
task_contract.worker_output: pure result keyed by task_id; worker PID/timing are execution metadata only
